estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Multiple regression analyses were standardized for estimated total calorie intakes and used to assess the association between each fat and incidence at each cancer site. estimate_classifications.reason: The fiber variable was included in ecological analyses of general cancer incidence that included prostate cancer; no aggressive endpoint was defined.
